title: 13-febe-matrix-transform-toolbar-bridges — curve rows and the per-object commit fix
what_changed: OM9-L3-04-01-016 Orient Perpendicular to Curve now runs: the picked point snaps to the nearest station and each object's construction-plane normal is aligned with the curve tangent.
OM9-L3-04-01-022 Array Along Curve now runs: copies land on equal arc-length stations measured with the owner length service.
Controller::commit_transform_mutations applies one step per object when a row hands in one step per target, which fixes Project To C-Plane for objects at different heights.

The owner services these two rows needed already existed (curve_ops::point_at/tangent_at/arc_length/length_between); the earlier 'no owner service' reason was wrong for them and is corrected in the records.
